name: EPPO Global Database API
tagline: Official pest and plant pathogen codes and taxonomy for plant health systems
description: The EPPO Global Database API provides programmatic access to EPPO codes, taxonomy, pest and pathogen data, and related plant health information used across quarantine, phytosanitary, and agricultural systems. It enables lookup of pests, plants, and regulatory status by EPPO code or name.

auth.details: API key required; exact header/param name and signup process need verification from official docs

use_cases: look up EPPO code for a pest or plant species
resolve pest taxonomy and preferred scientific name
check regulatory or quarantine status by EPPO code
search plant pathogens by common or scientific name
